resources.string: Shizuku is a free open-source app that passes shell permissions to other apps. This app uses it once, to grant two capture permissions. On Android 11 and later Shizuku starts with wireless debugging on the phone itself, so no PC is needed. After a reboot, start Shizuku again only if you want to redo the setup.
Shizuku is not installed. Choose where to get it. Nothing is downloaded automatically.
Samsung One UI and some other systems stop apps in the background to save battery. The sound then suddenly returns to the original. Two settings prevent this.
Tap the button and choose \"Allow\" in the system dialog.

• App info › Battery › \"Unrestricted\"\n• Settings › Battery › Background usage limits: keep this app out of \"Sleeping apps\" and \"Deep sleeping apps\", or add it to \"Never sleeping apps\", and turn off \"Put unused apps to sleep\" if you use it rarely.

On Android 14 and later a capture consent is valid for one session only. The system dialog \"Start recording or casting\" therefore appears each time processing starts, usually right after you turn the switch on.
Processed sound is delayed by about 0.15 s or more. Excluded apps play without this app and without delay; video and games stay in sync.
Add video, game and call apps
None of the listed video and call apps is installed, or all are already excluded. Add other apps, such as games, with the + button.
